title: CRUXEVAL-X: A Benchmark for Multilingual Code Reasoning, Understanding and Execution

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on code reasoning tasks across 19 different programming languages to measure the performance gap between predominantly represented languages (like Python) and less represented ones.

Evaluating models on code reasoning tasks (predicting input based on output, and predicting output based on input) rather than standard code generation tasks to highlight capability discrepancies across different types of coding tasks.

Assessing potential self-generation bias by having multiple different LLMs (e.g., Qwen, DeepSeek) generate benchmark data, and evaluating if a model gains an unfair advantage when tested on the data it generated itself.
